entities.summary: Jack Eugene Wilson is an American former professional baseball shortstop and current coach. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Pittsburgh Pirates, Seattle Mariners, and Atlanta Braves. After his playing career, he became a coach and is the manager of the Greeneville Flyboys in the collegiate Appalachian League.
